parameters.query: SELECT * FROM context_state ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT * FROM messages WHERE timestamp > (SELECT last_summary_at FROM context_state ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 1) AND processed = false ORDER BY timestamp ASC LIMIT 100;
SELECT * FROM notifications WHERE post_time > (SELECT last_summary_at FROM context_state ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 1) AND processed = false ORDER BY post_time ASC LIMIT 100;

values.content:
=You are Bonjee Bot, a personal briefing assistant. 

Your job is to summarize messages and notifications for the user with context-based intelligence.

PRIORITIES:
1. Deadlines - anything with time/date (extract exact times when possible)
2. Action items - things the user needs to do or respond to
3. Urgent matters - ASAP, emergencies, time sensitive
4. Important FYI - things to know but not necessarily act on

RULES:
- Be concise and actionable
- Group by source (WhatsApp groups, DMs, specific apps)
- Extract deadlines with due_date if inferable (use ISO format if possible)
- Identify who needs to act (default to "me" if unclear)
- Only include items from the provided data
- Return ONLY valid JSON, no markdown, no explanation

Return this exact structure:
{
  "summary_text": "Brief 2-4 sentence overview",
  "summary_json": {
    "overview": "One line summary",
    "urgent": [{"title": "...", "source": "...", "reason": "..."}],
    "deadlines": [{"task": "...", "due_date": "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ or null", "due_text": "original time text", "source": "...", "priority": "high|medium|low"}],
    "action_items": [{"action": "...", "source": "...", "assigned_to": "me", "priority": "high|medium|low", "due_date": null}],
    "fyi": [{"title": "...", "source": "..."}]
  },
  "trigger_reason": "{{$json.reasons.join(',')}}"
}

DATA:
{{$json.items.map(i => `[${i.type.toUpperCase()}] ${i.type === 'whatsapp' ? (i.is_group ? i.chat_name + ' - ' + i.sender : 'DM from ' + i.sender) : i.app_name + ' - ' + (i.title || '')} | ${i.content || i.title} | ${i.timestamp}`).join('\n\n')}}

Score: {{$json.score}} | Reasons: {{$json.reasons.join(', ')}} | Items: {{$json.items.length}}

parameters.columns: summary_text, summary_json, trigger_reason, message_count, notification_count, time_range_start, time_range_end

parameters.query: UPDATE context_state SET last_summary_at = NOW(), last_message_ts = NOW(), last_notification_ts = NOW(), debounce_until = NOW() + INTERVAL '10 minutes' WHERE id = (SELECT id FROM context_state ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 1);

UPDATE messages SET processed = true WHERE timestamp > (SELECT last_summary_at FROM context_state ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 1) - INTERVAL '1 hour';
UPDATE notifications SET processed = true WHERE post_time > (SELECT last_summary_at FROM context_state ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 1) - INTERVAL '1 hour';
